name: Lucky Charm

components.m: a four-leaf clover and a shard of broken mirror

targets.description: a Tiny, nonmagical object, handed to the ally you touch, who carries it

summary: Pass a charm of your luck to an ally for up to 1 hour: while they carry it they have Advantage on D20 Tests and you have Disadvantage.
text: You touch a Tiny, nonmagical object and pour some of your own luck into it. While a creature other than you carries it, that creature has Advantage on D20 Tests and you have Disadvantage on D20 Tests. Concentration, up to 1 hour. In the game the carrier is the ally you cast it on: the object is handed to that ally as you cast, and the effects begin on the cast and end with the spell.
